props.label: Walls engineered to hold
props.html:
What we do

Walls engineered to hold

A retaining wall is only as good as its footings and its drainage. We build engineered walls with ag-drainage behind them so moisture movement in the clay doesn't push the wall out over time.

We assess the slope and soil on site and quote a wall that suits your block and any council requirements.

Get a free quote

What's included

  • On-site slope and soil assessment
  • Engineered footings
  • Ag-drainage behind the wall
  • Proper backfill and compaction
  • Council-ready plans where required
  • Fixed-price quote, no call-out fee

props.label: Retaining walls FAQs
props.html:
Good to know

Retaining walls FAQs

Is my block suitable for a retaining wall on clay soil?
Almost always, but the build has to suit reactive Wianamatta clay. That means engineered footings and proper ag-drainage behind the wall so moisture movement does not push it out. We assess the slope and soil on site and quote a wall that will hold.
Do I need council approval for landscaping?
Many jobs like turf, garden beds and paving need no approval. Bigger retaining walls, structures near boundaries, or tree removal can need a development application or a permit. We flag anything that does before we start and can prepare council-ready plans. Confirm specifics with Campbelltown Council.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor, licence number 353-827-C. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
